general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, sliders, drag points, cart actions, view modes) MUST include data-testid='...' using kebab-case role naming e.g. data-testid='customizer-camera-wrist-button', data-testid='product-card-tryon-button-1', data-testid='finger-select-index'.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.currency_format: All prices MUST display currency in Indian Rupees (₹) with appropriate locale formatting e.g. ₹ 1,45,000.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_ai_disclaimer: Strictly NO artificial intelligence or virtual try-on webcam overlays. Showcase real code-rendered 3D WebGL mannequin and procedural jewelry physics.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.editorial_marquee: Include one slow-drifting editorial marquee ribbon at 0.05 speed with thin gold lettering and wide tracking.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Buttons and cards must feature gold border luminescence transitions and backdrop opacity shifts on hover.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text-to-background contrast exceeds APCA standards on dark surfaces. Form controls and inputs must have distinct focus rings with gold tint.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 3D Try-On Customizer using @react-three/fiber Canvas with custom OrbitControls and camera transitions driven by Framer Motion or GSAP.
Implement named anchors for hand/wrist/fingers/neck on the procedural mannequin geometry.
Ensure products in the catalog sidebar have a 'TRY ON' button and HTML5 drag-and-drop handles that trigger auto-placement onto mannequin anchors.
Build the Finger Picker overlay when a ring product is chosen or dragged to the hand.
Provide interactive adjustment sliders (Scale, Rotate Y, Stack position offset) in the Worn Items control panel.
All components must be written as React Javascript (.js / .jsx) files.
Add test IDs (`data-testid`) to all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal controls, and product cards.
